name: Urusei Yatsura ~Koi no Survival Birthday~
original_name: うる星やつら 〜恋のサバイバル・バースディ〜
source:
Scenario is original from the anime. We get and invitation to Okiko birthday party. The person who finds her first is going to get a kiss, so a fierce competition among the invited guests ensues.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作采用动画原创剧情。我们收到邀请，参加面堂了子的生日派对。最先找到她的人可以得到一个吻，于是受邀宾客之间展开了激烈竞争。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
